card.name: Period in section numbers like 7.1
card.fires_on: The period after a single-digit section number in a numbered heading, where a subsection number such as 1 or 2 comes next. Seen most in drug-label headings such as '7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7.1'.

modes.label: Drug label subsections
modes.description: Period after the section number 7 in the DRUG INTERACTIONS heading, just before 1.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7<<.>>1 Effect of ORBACTIV on

modes.label: Numbered web lists
modes.description: Period after a digit in numbered items or sections of general web text.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a digit such as 1 next, as in a subsection number.
card.plain: It marks the dot inside a section number like 7.1, where a subsection number follows.
